name: allinone
description: All-in-One Claude Code skill stack: caveman, ponytail, superpowers, taste-skill, graphify vendored as one install — plus obsidian-vault MCP bootstrap

plugins.name: allinone
plugins.description: Meta layer: unified rules, /allinone check|install, obsidian MCP + graphify CLI bootstrap. The other plugins below ship with it.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Shortens prose while preserving technical terms, code, commands, and exact errors. Vendored from juliusbrussee/caveman (MIT).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions. Vendored from dietrichgebert/ponytail (MIT).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Core skills library: TDD, debugging, brainstorming, collaboration patterns, and proven techniques. Vendored from obra/superpowers (MIT).

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Frontend design taste skills: brutalist, minimalist, soft, redesign, stitch, imagegen, and more. Vendored from Leonxlnx/taste-skill (MIT).

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Codebase to knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query tools. Skill vendored; CLI (graphifyy) installed via pip on first run.
